subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What live evidence is sufficient before OpenClaw queues a fix for this reaction-only Slack Socket Mode zero-envelope failure?
rationale: Current source already has reaction handlers and binding-aware routing, so choosing a fix without live envelopes would guess between Slack/Bolt non-delivery, account filtering, and authorization suppression.

options.title: Require live reaction envelope proof
options.body: Keep this open and ask for redacted current-main Socket Mode envelopes, status output, and trace logs before queueing a fix.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat the broader Slack Socket Mode issue as canonical only after it gets public diagnostics proving the same reaction event family or root cause.

options.title: Close against the routing fix
options.body: Close as already fixed only if current-main live proof shows reaction envelopes now reach the gateway and route correctly.

recommendation.title: Require live reaction envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for redacted current-main Socket Mode envelopes, status output, and trace logs before queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question centers on the Slack system-event routing path and prior merged reaction-session fix authored by this owner candidate.
